description: Voltage traces for one representative accepted C-neuron variant (and an A-beta comparator at 20 Hz). Time in ms from the start of stimulation; voltage in mV rounded to 0.1. Model units; intracellular current injected at the mid-stem of a simplified model, not a clinical amplitude or a stimulation setting. stim_times are the 1 ms pulses at the mid-stem; test_times are the peripheral probe pulses (2 Hz mean).
